description: This Java class defines an authentication service (AuthService) that handles user registration and login functionalities, interacting with a UserRepository and managing user data transfer objects (DTOs).

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Provides methods for user registration and login, utilizing UserRepository for persistence and handling User DTOs.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Creates a new User entity from registration request data and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by email and password, returning a LoginResponse if successful.
